{{Short description|Section of the UK Mathematics Trust}}
The '''British Mathematical Olympiad Subtrust''' ('''BMOS''') is a section of the [[United Kingdom Mathematics Trust]] which currently runs the [[British Mathematical Olympiad]] as well as the UK Mathematical Olympiad for Girls,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bmoc.maths.org/home/ukmog-2012.pdf |title=UK Mathematical Olympiad for Girls |publisher=Bmoc.maths.org |accessdate=2012-10-29}}</ref> several training camps throughout the year such as a winter camp in [[Hungary]], an Easter camp at [[Trinity College, Cambridge]], and other training and selection of the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] team. Since 1999, it also organizes the [[UK National Mathematics Summer Schools]].<ref name=autogenerated1>{{cite web|url=http://www.bmoc.maths.org/ |title=The British Mathematical Olympiad Subtrust (BMOS) and Committee (BMOC) |publisher=Bmoc.maths.org |date= |accessdate=2012-10-29}}</ref> It was established alongside the British Mathematical Olympiad Committee (BMOC) in 1991 with the support of the [[Edinburgh Mathematical Society]], [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]], the [[London Mathematical Society]], and the [[Mathematical Association]], each nominated two members. The BMOS replaced some of the Mathematical Association's activities.<ref name=autogenerated1 /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://acronyms.thefreedictionary.com/British+Mathematical+Olympiad+Subtrust |title=British Mathematical Olympiad Subtrust - What does BMOS stand for? Acronyms and abbreviations by the Free Online Dictionary |publisher=Acronyms.thefreedictionary.com |date= |accessdate=2012-10-29}}</ref>

==History==
In 1996, the United Kingdom Mathematics Trust (UKMT) was set up to manage competitions of this nature, though the BMOC remained in charge of the senior olympiads.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ukmt.org.uk/ |title=ukmt.org.uk |publisher=ukmt.org.uk |date= |accessdate=2012-10-29}}</ref><ref name=autogenerated2>{{cite web|url=http://www.bmoc.maths.org/home/history.shtml |title=BMOS/BMOC: History |publisher=Bmoc.maths.org |date= |accessdate=2012-10-29}}</ref>

==Problems group==
The 'problems group' is a subsection of the BMOS which is responsible for supplying new and interesting problems for use domestic competitions and for submission to the IMO each year.<ref name=autogenerated2 />
